topIssues.title: Implement ConditionalDeployer contract
topIssues.author: maurelian
topIssues.body:
### Description
A minimal contract that checks for create2 collisions and conditionally forwards initcode to the deterministic-deployer contract to preserve deterministic deployment addresses.

### References
https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/8f49778644d4a16cc8c7ec73ed80ae8290a709e7/protocol/l2-contract-upgrades.md?plain=1#L85-L103

### Acceptance Criteria / Definition of Done
Contract forwards initcode to deterministic-deployer on no collision, returns without reverting on collision when called with properly formed inputs.

topPRs.title: chore(contracts-bedrock): bump Solidity version to 0.8.25
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Experimental PR to bump the Solidity compiler version in `packages/contracts-bedrock/` from 0.8.15 to 0.8.25.

- Updated 290 Solidity files across `src/`, `test/`, and `scripts/`
- Updated vendor EAS files from 0.8.19 to 0.8.25
- Updated `^0.8.15` floating pragmas to `^0.8.25`
- Left `^0.8.0`, `^0.8.8`, `^0.8.9`, `^0.8.13`, `^0.8.24`, and range pragmas unchanged (already compatible)
- Patch-bumped 54 contracts that showed bytecode changes
- Updated all hardcoded version expectations in validators and deploy scripts

## What Changed

| Category | Files | Details |
|----------|-------|---------|
| Pragma updates | 290 | `0.8.15` -> `0.8.25`, `0.8.19` -> `0.8.25`, `^0.8.15` -> `^0.8.25` |
| Version bumps | 54 | Patch bump all contracts with bytecode changes |
| Artifact disambiguation | 2 | `vm.getDeployedCode` path-qualified for `Proxy.sol` |
| Gas boundary tests | 1 | `SafeCall.t.sol` threshold adjustments |
| Hardcoded versions | 3 | `OPContractsManagerStandardValidator`, `DeploySaferSafes` script + test |
| Check scripts | 2 | `strict-pragma` test data, `semver-diff` exclusions |

## Decisions Made

1. **Vendor EAS files bumped to 0.8.25** -- Kept everything on a single compiler version to avoid artifact collisions.

2. **Left `^0.8.0` and other float pragmas alone** -- Libraries, interfaces, and utility files use floating pragmas that are already compatible.

3. **Path-qualified `vm.getDeployedCode` calls** -- With all contracts compiling under 0.8.25, some contracts sharing names with OpenZeppelin dependencies (e.g., `Proxy.sol`) produced ambiguous artifacts. Fixed by using path-qualified names.

4. **Updated gas boundary test constants** -- 0.8.25 generates slightly more efficient bytecode (PUSH0 opcode), reducing gas thresholds by 8-17 gas units in SafeCall tests.

5. **Excluded inheriting-version contracts from semver-diff** -- L1BlockCGT, L2StandardBridgeInterop, L2ToL1MessagePasserCGT use `string.concat(super.version(), suffix)` which the semver-diff check cannot parse. Added them to the exclusion list since parent versions are already validated.

6. **Updated OPContractsManagerStandardValidator** -- Hardcoded `preimageOracleVersion()` from 1.1.4 to 1.1.5 to match the bumped PreimageOracle.

## Complexity Report

**Moderate complexity, but highly mechanical.** Summary:

1. **Artifact name collisions** (key finding): When contracts-bedrock used 0.8.15 and OZ v5 used `^0.8.20`, Foundry compiled them with different compiler versions and could disambiguate artifacts. With both at 0.8.25, contracts with the same file name (e.g., `Proxy.sol`) collide. This is the most architecturally significant issue.

2. **54 version bumps needed** (mechanical): Every contract's bytecode changes with a new compiler, requiring patch bumps. This is the bulk of the diff.

3. **Gas boundary tests** (expected): Exact gas thresholds changed by 8-17 units.

4. **No breaking language changes**: Zero compilation errors despite 10 minor versions. `selfdestruct` deprecation already suppressed. No `block.difficulty` usage.

5. **Validator expectations**: The `OPContractsManagerStandardValidator` hardcodes expected contract versions, requiring updates when versions change.

## Side Effects

- **All 290 files** show pragma changes
- **54 contracts** have patch version bumps
- **semver-lock.json** regenerated (all bytecode hashes changed)
- Gas constants changed in SafeCall.t.sol
- `vm.getDeployedCode` paths changed in L2Genesis.s.sol and Predeploys.t.sol
- `check-semver-diff.sh` now excludes 3 inheriting-version contracts
- **No ABI changes** -- all changes are bytecode-only

## Test Results

- Build: passing (645 files compiled with single Solc 0.8.25)
- Tests: 2210 passed, 0 failed, 108 skipped
- `check-fast`: 17/17 checks passing

## Key Solidity changes available with 0.8.25

- 0.8.18: `block.prevrandao` (replaces `block.difficulty`)
- 0.8.20: Default EVM target changed to Shanghai (PUSH0 opcode)
- 0.8.22: Deprecation warnings for various features
- 0.8.24: Transient storage (`tstore`/`tload`), `mcopy`
- 0.8.25: Bug fixes and stability improvements

## Test plan

- [x] `just build-dev` passes (zero warnings)
- [x] `just test-dev` passes (2210/2210 tests, 108 skipped)
- [x] `just check-fast` passes (17/17 checks)
- [ ] CI checks (watching)

topPRs.title: exp: upgrade Solidity pragmas to 0.8.25
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Experimental PR to assess the complexity of upgrading all Solidity smart contracts in contracts-bedrock to Solidity 0.8.25. This PR contains the pragma changes to prove the compiler upgrade compiles and to surface all required follow-up work.

## What Changed

- 509 files modified (pragma changes only)
- All src/test/scripts use strict `pragma solidity 0.8.25`
- All interfaces use floating `pragma solidity ^0.8.25`
- Strict-pragma checker exclusion list cleared (7 files now use strict pragmas)

## CI Results

| Check | Status | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| Build | PASS | Compiles clean under 0.8.25 |
| Upgrade tests (9/9) | PASS | Fork tests against mainnet all pass |
| Regular tests (6/6) | FAIL | vm.getDeployedCode artifact ambiguity |
| Checks | FAIL | Snapshots need regeneration |

## Blocking Issues Found

### 1. vm.getDeployedCode Artifact Ambiguity (blocks regular tests)

All regular tests fail with `vm.getDeployedCode: multiple matching artifacts found` in setUp(). This is caused by Foundry's `additional_compiler_profiles` creating duplicate artifacts when the Solidity version changes. Requires investigation with local forge tooling.

### 2. Snapshot Regeneration (blocks checks)

semver-lock.json, ABI, and storage layout snapshots need regeneration. Requires `just snapshots` with forge locally.

### 3. Version Bumps (blocks semver-diff check)

67 contracts need patch version bumps (version strings + @custom:semver tags) plus 2 test assertion updates. This is mechanical but must be done after snapshots are regenerated.

### 4. Gas-Related Test Failures (2 tests)

`test_callWithMinGas_noLeakageHigh_succeeds` and `test_callWithMinGas_noLeakageLow_succeeds` have assertion failures, likely due to different gas costs with the new compiler.

## Complexity Assessment

| Task | Difficulty | Scope |
|------|-----------|-------|
| Pragma changes | Trivial | 509 files, mechanical |
| Artifact ambiguity fix | Medium | Needs forge investigation |
| Snapshot regeneration | Trivial (needs tooling) | Run just snapshots |
| Version bumps | Mechanical | 67 contracts + 2 tests |
| Gas test fixes | Low-Medium | 2 tests need investigation |
| Code changes for 0.8.25 compat | **Zero** | No breaking changes |

## Key Finding

The Solidity compiler upgrade from 0.8.15 to 0.8.25 requires **zero code changes** for compatibility. The entire codebase compiles and the upgrade tests pass, proving functional equivalence. The blockers are all CI/tooling related (artifact resolution, snapshots, version bookkeeping), not compiler-related.

topPRs.title: exp: remove OPCMv1 entirely, make v2 the only path
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Strip OPCMv1 contracts (OPContractsManagerBase, OPContractsManagerGameTypeAdder, OPContractsManagerUpgrader, OPContractsManagerDeployer, OPContractsManagerInteropMigrator, OPContractsManager facade, OPContractsManagerContractsContainer) to type-only shells, keeping only struct/error definitions as a type namespace
- Remove all `DevFeatures.OPCM_V2` conditional branches -- v2 is now unconditionally enabled
- Remove v1-only test files (OPContractsManager.t.sol, OPContractsManagerContractsContainer.t.sol) and v1 test code paths
- Clean up unused imports across deploy scripts, test setup, and production contracts
- Update semver-lock and ABI snapshots to reflect the changes

## Decisions Made

- **Kept struct/error type definitions**: OPCMv1's interface types (structs, errors, enums) are still referenced by v2 code and external consumers. Only the implementation code was removed.
- **Made OPCM_V2 always-on in FeatureFlags**: Rather than removing the bit entirely (which could break op-deployer bitmap compatibility), the bit is set unconditionally in `resolveFeaturesFromEnv()` and the constant is marked `@custom:legacy`.
- **Removed `Config.devFeatureOpcmV2()`**: Dead code after FeatureFlags change.
- **Removed `ForkLive._doUpgrade` (v1 path)**: Dead code after always-v2 change.
- **Removed v1-only test** `test_verifyOpcmImmutableVariables_mismatch_fails` in VerifyOPCM.t.sol since it was gated behind `skipIfDevFeatureEnabled(OPCM_V2)`.

## Complexity Report

The change touched 51 files with -6,435 / +4,863 lines (net deletion of ~1,572 lines). The main complexity was the sheer number of files with `DevFeatures.OPCM_V2` conditionals -- 30+ files across deploy scripts, test files, and production code. Each conditional needed to be analyzed to determine whether to keep the v2 branch, the v1 branch, or neither.

Surprisingly, nothing broke in unexpected ways -- once the feature flag was made always-on, all the v1 test paths simply became dead code that could be removed cleanly.

## Side Effects

- `OPContractsManager` removed from `semver-lock.json` (no longer a deployable contract)
- ABI snapshot `snapshots/abi/OPContractsManager.json` deleted (type-only shell has no ABI)
- 90 tests now skip fewer (tests previously gated behind `skipIfDevFeatureDisabled(OPCM_V2)` now always run)

## Validation

- `just build-dev`: passing
- `just test-dev`: 2206 passed, 0 failed, 90 skipped
- `just pr`: all 17/17 checks passing
